Miles Types

AlFursan members have two types of earning schemes to enjoy, Tier Credits and Rewards Miles.
AlFursan members will earn Miles and Credits from flying with Saudia and SkyTeam partners, as well as by engaging in exclusive partner and program offers.

Tier Credits

Tier Credits are earned by travel only on Saudia or SkyTeam partner flights, or on exclusive AlFursan offers. In terms of flights they are calculated based on flight distance and class of travel and accumulated within one calendar year (from 1 January to 31 December). It is one of the methods by which a member can upgrade their Tier level to help them enjoy exclusive Tier benefits. A member will use Tier Credits to upgrade from Green Tier to Silver Tier or Silver Tier to Gold Tier.

Reward Miles

Miles earned by travel or by our Air or non-Air partners. It is a reward for traveling on Saudia or SkyTeam partners. In addition, Reward Miles are earned by engaging in our exclusive partner offers or by using our AlFursan Miles earning Credit Cards. You can redeem your Reward Miles faster when you move to Silver (Elite) or Gold (Elite Plus) where you are awarded additional Miles depending on your membership level. Reward Miles can be redeemed on Reward Tickets and flight upgrades with Saudia.

Example: The following table shows how to earn Tier Credits and Reward Miles when traveling on Saudia flights from Jeddah - Dubai in the Economy class:

Below table to illustrate earning Miles if the member of the AlFursan hold the Silver level (Elite) and traveled on the route (Jeddah - Dubai) * on the economy class.

AlFursan member will earn both types of Miles as follows:

  1. 1048 Miles are added to the membership Tier Credits, which are the actual Miles of economy Class (Y).
  2. 1310 Miles added to the bonus Miles balance (1048 Miles of actual flight + 262 Miles (25% additional Miles for Silver Elite level))

* The numbers in the example are for illustration only and are not actual flight numbers.

Reward Miles 1048 Miles 1310 Miles 1572 Miles

Bonus Miles

Bonus Miles based on membership Tier and class of travel

The more you travel, the more you have the chance to upgrade your membership, and get more Reward Miles. Silver members (Elite) earn 25% extra bonus Miles and Gold Plus (Elite Plus) members earn 50% extra Bonus Miles from the total Miles earned (including Miles for Travel Class), are credited to Reward Miles.

Your travel on Saudia domestic and international flights will give you bonus Miles according to the membership level as shown in the following table:
